content:
The **Poseidon Power Substation PX-03** is a location in the Toxic Valley region of Appalachia.

This fenced-off power station has one shack containing some junk items. It is populated with several Scorched. There is a power box here that requires activating the Poseidon Energy Plant WV-06.

The Poseidon Power Substation PX-03 appears in *Fallout 76*.
